28-09-01A.txt:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS
      No restrictions.
   FLIGHT CREW

   ON GROUND OR IN FLIGHT
      On the FUEL SD page, monitor the fuel temperature using the fuel temperature indications of the
      opposite wing, before takeoff and periodically during the flight.
      Note:     For fuel temperature limits, Refer to AFM/LIM-28 Fuel Temperature Limits.
       If fuel temperature reaches limits:
         Before takeoff:
             Delay takeoff and shut down the engine on the affected side.
            In flight:
             ‐ Increase the engine fuel flow on the affected side.
             ‐ If necessary use the APU GEN and switch off the IDG on the affected side (if the
                opposite GEN is available).

28-28-01B.t: from the ACT(s) to the center tank operative)
28-28-01B.txt:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS
     No restrictions.
  FLIGHT CREW

  DURING COCKPIT PREPARATION
     Establish cockpit to ground communications for the following procedure.
     REFUEL PANEL DOOR...........................................................................................................OPEN
     The refuel panel door must be open to check the operation of the manual transfer.
      If the center tank is full:
         ACT pb-sw ...........................................................................................................CHECK AUTO
         TEST sw ............................................................................... SELECT AND MAINTAIN HI. LVL
         Manual fuel transfer from the ACT(s) to the center tank is usually performed with the center
         tank not full (center tank high level sensor dry). Therefore, if the center tank is full, keeping
         selected the TEST sw on the refuel/defuel control panel overrides the high level sensor.
            CAUTION             When the ACT pb-sw is set to FWD, fuel may spill out from the center tank
                                to the left surge tank. Once manual fuel transfer is checked operative, set
                                immediately the ACT pb-sw to AUTO. Otherwise, fuel may spill out from the
                                left tank.
     ACT pb-sw .................................................................................................................................FWD
     FUEL SD page ................................................................................................................. MONITOR
     Manual fuel transfer is checked operative when one of the following occurs:







     ‐ The ACT to center tank fuel transfer indication is fully green
     ‐ The fuel quantity of one ACT decreases (ACT 1, or ACT 2  if not empty).
     ACT pb-sw ............................................................................................................................... AUTO
     TEST sw ............................................................................................................................RELEASE
     REFUEL PANEL DOOR.........................................................................................................CLOSE
  30 MIN AFTER TAKEOFF
     ACT pb-sw .................................................................................................................................FWD
     FUEL SD page ................................................................................................................. MONITOR
     Check that the fuel is transferred from the ACTs to the center tank.
     If necessary perform a descent to FL 270.
      When ACT (both ACTs if two ACTs installed) is empty:
          ACT pb-sw ........................................................................................................................ AUTO

28-28-04D.txt:
FLIGHT PLANNING RESTRICTIONS
     No restrictions.
  FLIGHT CREW






  DURING COCKPIT PREPARATION
     1. The refuel panel door must be open to check the operation of the manual transfer on the ground
        using the FUEL SD page. Establish ground communications and ensure that the refuel panel
        door is open during following check and closed after the check is done.
     2. The manual transfer may be performed only if the center tank is not full (center tank high
        level sensor dry). If the center tank is full, the high level sensor may be overridden by keeping
        pressed in the HI LVL pb test of the refuel panel. When the high level sensor is overridden, take
        care to not overfill the center tank. Otherwise, fuel may spill out from the surge tanks.
     ‐ ALL ACT pb ................................................................................................... CHECK NOT ISOL
     ‐ ACT XFR rotary selector .............................................................................APPROPRIATE ACT
       Select the ACT to be transferred in sequence FWD - AFT2 - AFT1. On the FUEL SD page,
       disregard any pulsing indication of the fuel quantity during the application of the procedure.
     ‐ ACT XFR MODE SEL pb-sw ................................................................................................MAN
     ‐ On the FUEL SD page, check that the fuel is transferred from the selected ACT to the center
       tank.
     ‐ ACT XFR rotary selector ....................................................................................................... OFF
     ‐ ACT XFR MODE SEL pb-sw ..............................................................................................AUTO
